identity.name: BingX Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. Perp

about.description: CRDO is a single-stock perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
